data.exact_reserve_text:
Losses and loss adjustment expenses are GBP 35.6m higher than 2015 resulting in an increase in the loss ratio from 54.3% to 67.3%. The main driver for the increase is due to adverse prior year development of GBP 10.3m as compared to GBP 9.3m favorable prior year development during the same period in 2015.

The adverse development in 2016 is mainly attributable to the Personal Accident line of business which during 2016 booked losses from prior years (GBP 6.0m). There were also prior year losses in Property and DUAL Australia that contributed to the higher loss ratio.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net adverse prior-year reserve movement (gross) of approximately GBP 9.4m in 2016 (a strengthening of reserves of ~4.2% versus opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 223.5m). The deterioration was concentrated in prior-year development, principally driven by Personal Accident (with ~GBP 6.0m of prior-year losses booked) and additional prior-year losses in Property and Australian operations. The figure above is derived from the gross claims development triangle and is consistent with the narrative that prior-year development was adverse in 2016.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 44). The Managing Agent narrative quotes an 'adverse prior year development of GBP 10.3m' (page 2) but does not explicitly state whether that is gross or net; the triangle-based gross calculation yields ~GBP 9.38m. The narrative figure may be net of reinsurance or rounded; triangle-derived gross PYD used as primary quantity. Some LOB references (e.g. 'DUAL Australia') are mentioned without precise gross amounts and have been treated qualitatively.
